description: Regression vectors produced by the hw binary itself (hw 0.9.5, commit 2ebb5e7): accounts created with `hw createacc`, addresses from `hw receive`, signatures from `hw --json signmsg`, on a scratch database. The mnemonic is the public BIP-39 test mnemonic (11 x "abandon" + "about"); "TREZOR" is the BIP-39 test passphrase. All signatures were verified with Bitcoin Core 25.0 verifymessage.
